summary: Giyu Tomioka is a Demon Slayer of the Demon Slayer Corps and the current Water Hashira. He is one of the most skilled swordsmen in the organization and developed the Eleventh Form of Water Breathing, Dead Calm, himself. Giyu possesses exceptional physical ability, tactical intelligence, swordsmanship, and composure in battle.
